title: Never played with Petit; Sam and Isaiah Morgan bands
summary: He never played with Petit but did with Rena, Kelly and the Morgans; Isaiah took over after Sam was paralyzed; he had his own band under his name.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Did you ever play with him in the band?
No, Buddy, I never got a chance to play with Buddy in the band. I played with Renny, Chris Kelly, Sam Morgan, Isaiah Morgan, and those fellas.
Was that the regular Sam Morgan band or the Isaiah Morgan? Which group did you play with?
Well, Sam Morgan, he had his own band. And after he got paralyzed, his brother Isaiah Morgan, he took the band over. He played in his speech. Yeah. But one time, Isaiah Morgan, he was a band.
